nodes.name: When called by an intake workflow

parameters.query:
-- Claim the email + message hash for 24 h. The primary key on lead_claims makes two
-- identical submissions arriving together serialise: only one of them gets a row back.
WITH claim AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_claims (lead_hash, lead_id, claimed_at) VALUES ($2, $1, now())
  ON CONFLICT (lead_hash) DO UPDATE
    SET lead_id = EXCLUDED.lead_id, claimed_at = EXCLUDED.claimed_at
    WHERE lead_claims.claimed_at < now() - interval '24 hours'
  RETURNING lead_id
)
INSERT INTO leads (lead_id, lead_hash, source, status, name, email, company,
                   website_domain, personal_email, payload, execution_id)
SELECT $1, $2, $3, 'received', $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::boolean, $9::jsonb, $10
FROM claim
RETURNING lead_id;

-- No personal data is kept for spam: id, hash, source and reasons only.
INSERT INTO leads (lead_id, lead_hash, source, status, error, execution_id)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'rejected_spam', $4, $5)
RETURNING lead_id;
